svg.title: acdev: host Flox environment, per-project microVMs and the shared Nix cache path
svg.desc: On macOS, the acdev-demo Flox environment installs the acdev CLI, a cd shell hook and an nginx Nix cache proxy on port 8126. Changing into a project directory with .applecontainer.toml triggers acdev up and acdev shell, which start a microVM in Apple Container and activate the project's Flox environment. Each microVM fetches Nix packages through the host cache proxy at 192.168.64.1:8126 as an extra substituter.
